title: Debunked: Mehdi Joins Piers Morgan To Destroy Israeli Military Claims About Murdered Journalists
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
On October 1, the Israeli military [tweeted a
video](https://x.com/mehdirhasan/status/2105680971974758551?s=20) attacking
**Mehdi** and **Piers Morgan** , among others, for their reporting on
journalists killed in Gaza since the genocide began; "fake news," the video
called it. Today, Mehdi joined Piers on his show, 'Piers Uncensored,' to
debunk the Israeli report that followed that tweet, which included a long list
of journalists it claims were Hamas operatives, with little to no evidence of
their affiliation with the militant group.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Palestinian-American political analyst **Omar Baddar** also joined Mehdi to
debate Netanyahu ally, **Amit Segal** , and former Israeli military
spokesperson **Jonathan Conricus** on the latest out of Israel. The debate
covered:

  * The death toll in Gaza

  * The new documentary, "Naza," which uncovered war crime testimonies from Israeli soldiers

  * The Israeli military's history of lies and deception

  * The FlyDubai plane hijacking attempt and the conspiracies surrounding it
